receipt.normalization: none; preserve complete parsed native JSON values
receipt.scope: one original-order offline native-batch grouped-array observation; corpus 1000 of 1000 candidates

scope: Only observed checked contradiction branches have timers. A tactic can produce several branch checks and later fall back; record counts are not a mutually exclusive success rate. Source bodies identify groups, not individual repeated candidate instances. Failed/unsupported paths lack these timers and their cost is unknown, never zero. Rust linear/products/LP timers are nested inside Lean search roundtrip; do not add parent and child times. Serialized/overlapping invocation wall is not total CPU, a complete wall fraction, or an ideal GPU bound. Headline whole times already include all failed work and fallback. Native response agreement must be checked separately.
